create_random_dataset: create a RandomDataset with N samples, dimension d, and gaussian or uniform noise
regenerate_random_dataset: regenerate the RandomDataset to produce fresh random samples with the same parameters
init_dataset_gaussian: init a gaussian or uniform random dataset with configurable size and standard deviation
init_dataset_mnist: init the MNIST dataset with tensor transforms and normalization for training and eval
init_dataset_cifar10: init the CIFAR10 dataset with data augmentation for training and standard transforms for eval
